research_scope: Read-only public Foodpanda research for currently blank Menu / Price records. Ten item/price proposals across two exact outlet-specific pages. Branch-level identity was checked against current workbook SFA licence, street, building, unit and postcode; existing Menu Items sheet checked for both licence IDs and contained no items for either outlet. No paid services or API calls, login, ordering, or image reuse.

outlets.confidence: high for listing-to-SFA branch crosswalk and listed facts; medium for current price freshness due index crawl date.

held_or_not_used: Foodpanda page images were visible, but they are platform-hosted assets and were not copied or proposed as image URLs; this task only gathered factual menu item/price text.
Foodpanda ratings and reviews were not proposed because this batch is scoped to menu item/price additions and review counts can be volatile.
A Foodpanda CLOSED / temporarily unavailable badge, where present on a listing, is not evidence of permanent closure and was not used to change outlet status.
No images, descriptions, stock visuals, or menu URLs are written to the workbook by this research batch.
limitations: Delivery menu availability and pricing can change and may differ from in-store prices.
Foodpanda page observation was made 2026-10-19, while indexed HTML crawl dates are one or two days earlier; recheck listing before workbook integration.
Komala’s Foodpanda address states unit 42 while SFA has 42/42A, matching the listed unit range but not reproducing the full range.
